headline.zh: 预览 HR 代理的筛选与入职流程
headline.en: Preview HR agent screening and onboarding

scenario.zh: 为科技公司运营岗位演示候选人筛选和入职准备，使用虚构简历和政策
scenario.en: Demonstrate candidate screening and onboarding prep for a tech company operations role using fictional resumes and policies

instruction.zh: 选择一份虚构简历开始
instruction.en: Pick a fictional resume to start

input.zh: Alex Chen, 5年 SaaS 运营经验，曾在 50 人团队管理客户成功流程，熟悉 Salesforce 和 HubSpot，擅长跨部门协作
input.en: Alex Chen, 5 years SaaS operations experience, managed customer success workflows in 50-person team, familiar with Salesforce and HubSpot, strong cross-functional collaboration

output.zh: 工具经验匹配职位要求，团队规模相近，建议面试时深入了解流程优化案例和数据分析能力
output.en: Tool experience matches requirements, team size is comparable, recommend interview to explore process improvement examples and data analysis skills

input.zh: Jordan Lee, 3年产品运营背景，支持过两次产品发布，参与用户研究和 A/B 测试，较少直接管理运营流程
input.en: Jordan Lee, 3 years product ops background, supported two product launches, involved in user research and A/B testing, limited direct operations process management

output.zh: 产品思维有价值但运营管理经验不足，若团队有导师资源可考虑培养，否则优先级较低
output.en: Product mindset valuable but operations management experience is limited, consider if mentorship available, otherwise lower priority

emphasis.zh: 较少直接管理运营流程

instruction.zh: 基于岗位生成入职清单
instruction.en: Generate onboarding checklist for the role

input.zh: 运营经理需管理客户工单流程、协调产品和支持团队、分析运营指标
input.en: Operations manager to manage customer ticket workflows, coordinate product and support teams, analyze operational metrics

detail.zh: 开通 Salesforce、Slack 工作区和内部文档库访问权限
detail.en: Grant Salesforce, Slack workspace, and internal doc access

detail.zh: 阅读客户工单 SLA 政策和上季度运营报告
detail.en: Review customer ticket SLA policy and last quarter ops report

detail.zh: 与产品经理和支持主管各安排一小时会议
detail.en: Schedule one-hour meetings with product manager and support lead

takeaway.zh: 演示了虚构简历筛选逻辑和入职任务生成，真实候选人评估和政策合规需在 Leapsome 平台完成
takeaway.en: Illustrated fictional resume screening logic and onboarding task generation; actual candidate evaluation and policy compliance must be completed on the Leapsome platform
